# Flags mainline llama-server accepts that the launcher does not use ON A
# MAINLINE LAUNCH, on purpose. Some of these (--webui, --defrag-thold, -dt)
# reach an ik_llama.cpp launch instead, through a Setting gated to that
# engine; this list only tracks mainline's unused surface. Catalogued
# flags and the command builder's structural aliases are accounted for
# elsewhere and never appear here.
# Regenerating llama_server_flags_<build>.txt fails the suite
# on any accepted flag that is neither catalogued nor listed here, so a
# new upstream flag forces a decision: add a Setting, or add a line here.
# A line here that the build no longer accepts fails the suite too.
